responses:
I checked the analysis against the tender. **It isn't ready to send.** The delivery finding gets the tender wrong, and the analysis leaves out most of the technical and commercial requirements.

## Findings review

| # | Finding | Source (doc / clause) | Applicability | Exceptions checked | Result |
|---|---------|-----------------------|---------------|--------------------|--------|
| 1 | "Delivery: 20 weeks from PO. Complies with 7.4." | tender.md §7.4: "Delivery shall be within 16 weeks of purchase order. Offers exceeding 16 weeks will be rejected." | APPLIES | §9 (special conditions, §9.3 precedence) doesn't change delivery time. Nothing overrides 7.4. | **CONTRADICTED.** 20 weeks is more than the 16-week limit, and the tender says offers like that will be rejected. |
| 2 | "IP66 offered vs IP65 required (4.5). Complies." | tender.md §4.5: "Panel and motor terminal enclosures shall be IP65 or better." | APPLIES (panels and motor terminal boxes) | Nothing in §9 changes this. | **VERIFIED.** IP66 is better than IP65: same dust rating, stronger water-jet protection. |

**Counts:** VERIFIED 1 · CONTRADICTED 1 · UNSUPPORTED 0 · NEEDS HUMAN 0

## Requirements the analysis missed

| Clause | Requirement | Applicability / notes |
|---|---|---|
| 4.1 | 400 V, 3-phase, 50 Hz supply | APPLIES to all equipment |
| 4.2 + **9.1** | IE3 minimum, but §9.1 requires **IE4 for pump motors above 75 kW**. §9.3 gives Section 9 precedence. | **P-01 (90 kW): IE4.** P-02 (37 kW): IE3 minimum |
| 4.3 + Annex B | ATEX Ex d for motors in Zone 1 | **P-01 (wet well, Zone 1): Ex d required.** P-02 (valve chamber, non-hazardous): not required |
| 4.4 | Power cables at least 2.5 mm² | APPLIES. Size per load: 2.5 mm² is only a floor and won't be enough for the 90 kW motor. |
| 7.1 | 24-month warranty **from commissioning**, not from delivery | APPLIES |
| 9.2 | 50 °C ambient design temperature | APPLIES. Standard motors are rated for 40 °C, so you need derating or 50 °C-rated motors and panels. |
| 9.3 | Section 9 overrides Sections 4 and 7 if they conflict | Set this precedence explicitly in the offer |

## Verdict

**NO-GO.** As written, the offer would be rejected under §7.4: either bring delivery down to 16 weeks or less, or get a written deviation from the issuer. Before you send it, also confirm and add to the analysis:
- IE4 and ATEX Ex d for P-01
- 50 °C ambient rating for motors and panels
- warranty starting at commissioning
- 400 V / 50 Hz supply and cable sizing
